rules: Every claim must reference at least one admitted source unit.
Atomic source text is not customer interpretation.
Customer meaning remains null until value-specific editorial/semantic admission in W4-W11.
Composition requires an admitted compositionRuleId and may not be string concatenation.
Unknown or source-pending values remain unknown; AI may not fill them as fact.
Sensitive source material marked BOUNDARY_REWRITE_REQUIRED must be rewritten and reviewed before semantic admission.
R2 24/24 human acceptance does not admit any R3 claim.
